item.title: City of Morgantown to offer new municipal ID cards to residents
item.description: In an effort to help low-income residents obtain legal identification, the City of Morgantown will soon begin offering its own municipal ID cards.

item.title: Tourism Day at West Virginia Capitol supports economic development
item.description: Vendors and organizations all came together under one roof of the West Virginia Capitol dome to celebrate what makes West Virginia "Almost Heaven."

item.title: How the Katherine Johnson IV&V facility in Fairmont helps prevent NASA disasters
item.description: Wednesday marked the 40-year anniversary of the Challenger space shuttle tragedy, which claimed the lives of seven people and prompted the opening of a local NASA office to prevent those kind of disasters from ever happening again.

item.title: West Virginia plumbers, firefighters give ways to prevent water pipes from freezing
item.description: With freezing temperatures persisting for the foreseeable future, 12 News spoke with the local experts, Midstate Plumbing and Air Owner Kurtis Troy, and Bridgeport Fire Lieutenant Ben Tacy, on how to prevent water pipes from freezing.

item.title: PA man charged after allegedly robbing Morgantown CVS
item.description: A man has been arrested and is facing charges after officers with the Morgantown Police Department say he tried to rob the CVS location on High Street.

item.title: Bridgeport Sheetz employee allegedly embezzled thousands of dollars
item.description: A woman has been arrested in Harrison County and is facing charges after officers with the Bridgeport Police Department say she embezzled thousands of dollars from the Bridgeport Sheetz location.

item.title: WVU basketball opponent temporarily stranded in West Virginia
item.description: After losing to WVU 59-54 on Tuesday, the Kansas State men's basketball team was stuck overnight in the Mountain State.

item.title: Morgantown man allegedly uploaded child porn using a fake name
item.description: A Morgantown man has been arrested and is facing charges after detectives with the Monongalia County Sheriff's Office say he uploaded child sexual abuse material (CSAM) to a Dropbox using a fake name.

item.title: Man allegedly led Bridgeport police on high speed chase while drunk
item.description: A man has been arrested in Harrison County and is facing charges after officers say he fled from them while drunk at speeds up to 117 miles per hour.

item.title: Body found amid heavy police presence along I-79 in Marion County
item.description: The West Virginia Medical Examiner has been dispatched to a scene off Interstate 79 in Marion County that has drawn a heavy police presence.
